# Velair 1.9.0-beta.9

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Fixed decimal temperature entry losing typed digits in schedule, template and Profile editors. Decimal points and commas are accepted while incomplete values remain editable without being saved. Device temperature steps, limits, range ordering and Up/Down keyboard increments remain enforced. Thanks to **@pier-andre** for reporting [issue #64](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/64).
- Prevented false Manual adjustments when a climate kept off by Velair reports an out-of-range placeholder target, including delayed reports after the settling period. Both valid device limits are required; valid target changes, external HVAC changes and identifiable user or automation actions retain their usual handling. Thanks to **@bdonohoe** for reporting [issue #65](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/65).

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta follows [1.9.0-beta.8](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.0-beta.8) and introduces no configuration-format change.
- Decimal entry and keyboard stepping have been checked in isolated Chrome and WebKit sessions. Confirmation with the physical iOS keyboard/Companion app and the affected thermostat integration remains pending.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app.
